title: Reverse Pivot Shift
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Flex the knee to about seventy degrees with the patient relaxed, hold the foot, apply a valgus force and hold the tibia in external rotation.
Extend the knee slowly while keeping both forces applied, and feel for the lateral plateau reducing as the knee passes about twenty to thirty degrees.
Perform the dial test at thirty and ninety degrees in the same sitting, because that is the test the corner diagnosis will actually rest on.
A positive test with increased external rotation at thirty degrees only indicates the corner without the cruciate, and the dial test rather than this test is what establishes that.
